diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~69% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 12): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.407), which favours a weighted combination.

decision.justification: Selected 'best_single THETA' (an agent proposal) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score -0.2053. Series context: trend strength 0.924 and seasonal strength 0.7319; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.407); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.646.
